core_obligations: Given standard Anosov splitting, functional analysis, analytic Fredholm theory and the cited Sjostrand determinant/Jensen counting argument, the new proof must still construct a phase-space metric and anisotropic escape weight adapted to only Holder-regular stable/unstable distributions, establish their controlled variation and decay, and build a uniformly frequency-bounded absorbing resolvent through three distinct trapped/escaping/elliptic regions. The optimized transverse scale alpha_perp=1/(1+beta0), together with trace-class control of the trapped tube, yields the sharper unit-frequency bound <omega>^(n/(1+beta0)). The non-routine core is this Holder-adapted microlocal construction and uniform parametrix, not the final Jensen application or the sum/length of historical lemma cards. Count one H3 mainframework; parabolic wavefront and past/future consequences remain complete companion material.
